mentions.name: Bank Transaction Splitter
mentions.description: A desktop app that lets the user upload bank transaction CSVs and calculates how much money needs to be split with a partner, with plans to add simple subscription auditing logic.
mentions.problem: Shared expenses are easy to forget — the author routinely forgets to charge their partner for utilities or flight bookings, and dislikes going through the bank's UI.
mentions.source_excerpt: A little desktop app that lets me upload transaction csvs from my bank and figure out how much I need to split with my partner.

evidence.value: A little desktop app that lets me upload transaction csvs from my bank and figure out how much I need to split with my partner.
